ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) to 15% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous blobs cover the majority of both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edge boundary, the median notch base forming a wide triangular region, and as distinct linear and focal elements within the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 78 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the base of the fluke bifurcation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 2 and 12 pixels; most prominent on the outer thirds of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature transitioning to sharp distal tips; overall trajectory follows a wide, symmetrical concave sweep relative to the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered dark focal spots (2-8 pixels diameter) on the white field; significant textured reddish-brown clusters present at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark linear disruptions: one long diagonal mark on the left lobe; several oblique marks on the right lobe, including one prominent line ending in a circular terminal on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Reddish-brown tissue clusters or lesions located on the distal tips of both lobes; multiple healed linear pigmentation marks and rake-like scars across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive dark 'pin' marking on the inner right lobe near the notch, characterized by a straight line segment connected to a circular dark bulb.
